notes.title: Relaxing Drift Update
notes.notes:
Game Updates: What's New?

In the latest update of our game, important changes have been made that significantly improve the overall gaming experience:

1. Updated graphics – We have reworked the visual components for even greater aesthetics and realism. Enjoy improved graphics and detail.

2. Icon replacement – ​​A new set of icons makes the interface more intuitive and convenient to use. Now navigation in the game has become even easier!

3. Bug Fixes – Our developers have fixed a number of bugs, which improves the game's stability and performance.

4. Increased Map Size – We have expanded the maps to allow players to explore new locations and unlock more opportunities.

Thanks for staying with us and keep enjoying the game!
